pageProps.title: How to Train Your Dragon (2025)
pageProps.review: The live-action adaptation of 'How to Train Your Dragon' faithfully recreates the original story and its emotional resonance. With an adorable Toothless, it's a special treat for fans of the original.
pageProps.content:
## Review I loved that the live-action adaptation stayed faithful to the original story without unnecessary changes. I recommend this movie to fans who want to experience the emotion of the original once again.
Toothless is so cute.
